provenance.rights_note: Newly authored independent organic energy current geometry, forked meridian veins, flowing ruby-purple light, contact burst and six-second status mark, rasterized from transparent source strokes. Only micrograin luminance is sampled from the original FIST03 painterly impact artwork owned by this project. No fist sprite/weapon/item, no copied game UI, screen, GIF, or licensed commercial JX/VL asset is in the VFX atlas. This is code-authored source art, NOT individually ImageGen-painted masters; manual review is mandatory.
provenance.known_source_limitation: Original light-first form painted by Pillow/NumPy with FIST03 hand-painted luminance noise, not an independently ImageGen-painted high-resolution hero silhouette. Technical alpha uniqueness != organic motion/art acceptance; owner to review at 1x. Three bundled light filaments are one cosmetic streamed mark application; they are not multiple true combat hit receipts. R1 actual 1x Godot looked like a broad pink triangular arrow (ART_SELF_FAIL). R2 builds five intertwined crossing plasma ribbons with distinct wave poses and no circular head arc; marks/contact move to chest instead of obscuring face. Owner rejects R2 because it does not read as Duan Mach Lien Quan skill. R3 does 3 time-separated cosmetic pressure-echo punches near moving target, then visually tears 3 meridian branches, leaving 6-second interrupted vein mark. Three flashes are NOT 3 Combat V2 hits. Visual art still manual pending. Real R3 native Godot is still visually weak: scratch-like trails and caster mostly standing still. R4 improves martial choreography with fast LAB-only caster approach and wrist-origin charge flashes synchronized with three localized target-locked pressure echoes; contact scaled tighter to chest. Character frames unchanged; no rig. R4 video showed static-looking claw streaks even after caster martial rush. R5 re-authors all 12 pressure frames as impact-centered, compact irregular blooming qi compression, 3 beats x 4 distinct poses, changing center/radius/color. Does not introduce 3 gameplay hits. Mark application moved 28px lower so animated fractured veins hit chest rather than covering face.
